rationale: Builds directly on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact structural change: the recurrent carry target is no longer a fixed decoder-output anchor for every repeated tail block. Instead, later reverse-tail passes blend toward the progressively refreshed recurrent state in proportion to the staged recurrence gain. This stays compile-stable, keeps the export path unchanged, and targets one of the few locally promising categories: nearby reverse-tail anchor variants rather than another scalar sweep.
title: Reverse-Tail Refreshed Anchor Blend
